verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM has a first-party API, shown by a dedicated 'API Access & Keys' docs page and a server /api/ping endpoint, so programmatic access is a documented product capability. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches what the UI can do, and the probes found no published OpenAPI spec to check coverage against. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for UI features (workspaces, documents, agents, admin/user management, settings), a published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on confirmation of API-UI parity

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: fix: point k8s probes at the server's /api/ping
